shared_elements: human or anthropomorphic figure in profile
horizontal band of repeated geometric pattern
relief carving on an upright stone surface
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of profile figural relief together with horizontal patterned bands, especially repeated triangular/zigzag motifs. The biggest difference is compositional: A is a dense, multi-register surface with many small signs and figures, while B is dominated by one large seated or crouching figure on a much plainer fragment.
